meta.description: Registry for bounded selection-drift minimization conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

drift_minimization_entries.name: Selection Drift Minimization
drift_minimization_entries.purpose: Represent bounded admissibility-sensitive tradeoffs between local deviation minimization and long-term orientation drift stabilization.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: local_deviation_minimization_remains_defined
drift_minimization_conditions.description: The system must maintain formal metrics for evaluating single-step orientation error.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: long_term_orientation_drift_remains_bounded
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Cumulative frame error over multiple recursive steps must not exceed stability limits.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: selection_does_not_force_unique_trajectory
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Drift-minimization rules do not collapse the set of admissible continuation paths.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: orientation_bias_accumulation_detectable
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to track the buildup of systematic frame deviation.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: recursive_selection_updates_remain_admissible
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Each step in the drift-balanced selection sequence must satisfy current process windows.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: window_shrinkage_does_not_force_global_alignment
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Reduction in admissibility domain does not imply convergence to a unique global frame.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_drift_witness
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Pruning of high-drift branches must not eliminate all viable stabilization paths.

drift_minimization_conditions.name: transport_coupled_drift_instability_detectable
drift_minimization_conditions.description: Runaway drift triggered by nonlocal transport must be formally registerable.
